new.story: An Australian 20 cent piece from 2006 with Elizabeth II on the obverse. Australia's platypus 20c has been a pocket staple since decimalisation in 1966 — this one is cupronickel, the workhorse of Aussie small change.

source: NOID_Australia_2006_20Cent_obv.jpg: AUSTRALIA 2006 legend, Elizabeth II bust right; denomination by calibrated measurement — vertical 28.5/28.9mm (avg 28.7mm) vs 28.52mm spec (20c). 50c (31.65mm) 3mm outside uncertainty.
